description.en: Gudang is an inventory and warehouse dashboard for distributors, retail chains, and small businesses: switch between warehouses, track stock value and reorder points, manage products, record stock movements, receive purchase orders, move shipments from picking to delivered, and review suppliers, reports, and settings.
description.id: Gudang adalah dashboard inventori dan gudang untuk distributor, jaringan ritel, dan UMKM: berpindah antar gudang, pantau nilai stok dan titik pesan ulang, kelola produk, catat mutasi stok, terima purchase order, gerakkan pengiriman dari picking sampai terkirim, serta tinjau pemasok, laporan, dan pengaturan.
